SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺、ミルク・コーポレーションの…
え？？ミルク・コーポレーション！？

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wait… are you the son of Chairman Dong‑gu Park??
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 该、该不会是佟富贵会长的儿子吧？？

SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não me diga que... é filho do presidente Dong?

SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صبر کن... شما پسر رئیس دونگ گو پارک هستید؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 야, 아냐. 동 회장님 딸 하나 있어.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: No, he has just one daughter.

SCRIPT.SPANISH: No, el presidente Dong solo tiene una hija.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نه، او فقط یک دختر دارد.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, and I heard she’s really strict.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 而且聽說那個女兒超級強勢
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: しかもその娘、めちゃくちゃ厳しいって有名だぞ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah, dan katanya galaknya bukan main.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Dizem que ela é extremamente rígida.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، و من شنیدم که او واقعاً سختگیر است.

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ミルク・コーポレーションのしゃ…

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아오, 아... 진짜 깜짝 놀랬네 진짜 씨.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, wow… I really got scared for a second.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哎呦，啊...真是吓我一跳，我去

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah, wah… aku beneran sempat deg-degan barusan.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, meu Deus... me assustou de verdade.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah, por Dios… me asustó, de verdad.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، وای... من واقعا یک لحظه ترسیدم.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아 나 순간 사장이라는 줄 알았어
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, I actually thought you were the president for a moment.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我瞬间还以为是社长呢
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 真是的。我還以為你要說社長
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 今、一瞬ほんとに社長かと思った！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku juga tadi bener-bener kira kamu presidennya.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Por um momento, pensei que fosse o presidente.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Por un momento pensé que era el presidente.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، من واقعاً برای یک لحظه فکر کردم شما رئیس جمهور هستید.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 야 유나야 이건 너도 진짜 너무한 거야~
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, Yu-na, this is really too much on your part~

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Eh, Yu-na, ini keterlaluan banget sih kamu~

SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هی، یونا، این واقعاً از طرف تو خیلی زیاد است
